name: rch-port-tunnel
description: Optional standalone TCP forwarding tool with a dedicated authenticated channel. One Python program, Hub + Agent daemon roles. Separate from RCH Tunnel and its main Socket.

common-all.notes: Requires the target RCH Client Python (3.9+). This dedicated TCP channel is unencrypted; put it behind trusted networking or an encrypted overlay.

modules.name: port-tunnel-hub
modules.description: Accepts a dedicated TCP channel; configure whether Hub or Agent exposes the local listen port. Run one Hub and one Agent per mapping.

params.name: channel_host
params.label: Channel Bind Address
params.description: Use 0.0.0.0 only if the Agent must reach this machine over the network; protect the channel.

params.name: channel_port
params.label: Dedicated Channel Port
params.description: The same TCP port on both modules. Must be reachable from Agent to Hub.

params.name: expose_on
params.label: Expose Listening Port On
params.description: Which machine will open the forwarded listen port. Does not change channel dialing.

params.name: listen_host
params.label: Forward Listen Address
params.description: On the selected exposed machine, local bind address.

params.name: target_host
params.label: Target Host
params.description: Resolved on the opposite machine from the exposed listening port.

params.name: token
params.label: Shared Secret
params.description: Enter exactly the same secret (32–128 characters) on both modules. Stored in launch command arguments; avoid shared machines.

modules.name: port-tunnel-agent
modules.description: Dials the Hub from this Client. Uses the Hub mapping configuration; may expose the forwarded port locally.

params.name: hub_host
params.label: Hub Channel Address
params.description: Network-reachable address of the Hub channel (not the RCH Server Web URL).

params.name: channel_port
params.label: Dedicated Channel Port
params.description: The same TCP port on both modules. Must be reachable from Agent to Hub.

params.name: token
params.label: Shared Secret
params.description: Enter exactly the same secret (32–128 characters) on both modules. Stored in launch command arguments; avoid shared machines.
